items.session: PK=SESSION#<sid> SK=META | GSI1PK=USER#<userId> GSI1SK=SESSION#<createdAt>#<sid> | userId, device, ip, createdAt, revokedAt, familyId, expiresAtEpoch
items.refreshToken: PK=RT#<sha256(token)> SK=META | sid, userId, familyId, usedAt?, expiresAtEpoch

accessPatterns: refresh: GetItem RT#hash → conditional UpdateItem usedAt (rotation, reuse detection)
revoke one session: UpdateItem SESSION#sid revokedAt
list / revoke all sessions of a user: Query GSI1 USER#userId
_design.why: login/refresh are pure key lookups at 10k+/s with TTL expiry - no Postgres rows/vacuum for millions of short-lived tokens; uniformly distributed hash keys → no hot partition
